evidence: All five prompts plus the injected tests/app_context.md describe this app only. app_context.md:3 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat', :8-16 five accounts/password123/roles exactly match seed accounts and environment/instructions/walls-and-retention.md table (harriet partner, dev associate walled from M-12 = seed M-12 walled [dev], sian associate, gwen client M-11/M-13, paul client M-12); :20 key screens (matter list with unread counts, nested-reply thread, edit/delete/copy-link/hold, partner timer and wall controls, @ suggestions, mentions list, search, transcript) all trace to environment/instructions/conversations.md and walls-and-retention.md; :29 fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z = seed clock and integration.md. functional/prompt.md:13,76 gate account gwen@kittle.test exists; :65-70 restart_app on MCP server 'verifier' matches judge.toml [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='verifier' and restart_mcp.py TOOL name 'restart_app'; 'persistence criterion is last' matches the 16th criterion (persistence, judge.toml ~L265-279); :76-80 'Each session grades one criterion' matches mode='individual', isolated=false; the state summary (JUDGE messages, timers changed and restored, holds placed/released, walls added/lifted) matches criteria (timer set to 7 then back to 30, hold release of Insurer letter, wall add/lift of Dev and Sian). polish/prompt.md:32 and visual/prompt.md:49 reference functional-run state, consistent with test.sh run_suite using rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1; visual's 'M-13 (with its nested replies)' is true (seed K-9->K-8 plus functional JUDGE-R0..R3 chain). render/constraints prompts are template text plus checker block; their criteria name Kittle & Rowe, gwen/harriet, M-11. Diff vs frozen template: every CHANGE_ME in app_context is replaced; the template's generic 'accounts under Accounts' was replaced with a real account; no sibling product names (grep for HireOps, Colderwater, candidate, ticket, invoice, patient, acme, example.com outside a criterion's deliberate link text) found; all emails/matter ids in tests are in the seed (only *@kittle.test, M-11/12/13). Adversarial angle: a broken app cannot exploit any prompt inaccuracy because none was found; a conforming app could only be misjudged if prompts named wrong accounts/screens, which they do not. Minor observation (not a defect): app_context Key screens omits the 'earlier versions' view, but criteria that use it name it explicitly. This is a static accuracy row; no runtime measurement is required for it, and no full configured judge run exists per raw-evidence-index scope.
